title: w-3fe8 U1: Engram settings reset must clear stale session claims and carried checks
outcome: When a project's Engram is disabled, its binary path changes, or its authority store or home changes, every project session drops its work binding, carried checks, active turn checks and running command keys. Carried-check holders are told first, in EO wording. Observation custody is kept.
acceptance: update_project_engram_settings_checked in src/session_crud.rs, on Engram disabled, binary_path changed, or authority store/home changed, clears for every project session work_binding, carried_checks, active_turn_checks and running_command_keys and any other master-dropped field that still exists and is not observation custody, except ordinary queue and runtime facts (operator_paused, stopped_prompt_id, shell_directory, capture_workers, in-flight counters and context-nudge generations), which are kept
runtime_checkpoint, unadmitted_active_turn, unadmitted_closing_jobs, unadmitted_reports, the observation delete marker, workdir_worktree and the project-reset preview are kept

Before clearing, each carried-check holder receives the existing carried_checks_reset_lines notice worded for Execution Observability whose body has no credit language (the existing line-merge prefix is kept), persisted with the same commit discipline as the surrounding code
No gate or grant behaviour is revived
carried_checks::a_project_settings_reset_tells_the_holder_of_a_carried_gate keeps its cleared-state assertion and asserts the new notice wording, and passes on the compile owner's run
